lastCompletedStory.title: cam init scaffolds a commented [loop] section in project.toml

nextStoryContext: scaffoldLoopSection(projectToml) (src/commands/setup.ts, exported) is the dedicated final write for project.toml's commented [loop] example section (meta_loop, worker_isolation, orch_context_window), called at the very end of runSetup's project.toml write block, strictly AFTER every mergeIntoConfig call against the same path (mergeIntoConfig's saveConfig re-parses+re-serializes and silently drops comments on each call). It is idempotent: a no-op when config['loop'] is already defined, so a re-run of cam init (or an operator's hand-added active [loop] key) is never clobbered -- it does NOT merge new commented lines into an existing [loop] section. saveConfig (src/config/toml.ts) now takes an optional third `comments?: TomlComments` param forwarded to stringifyToml, closing the extension point US-001's own doc comment flagged. If a future story adds a 4th [loop] key (or a new commented section elsewhere), extend scaffoldLoopSection's hardcoded comment-lines array (keep enum/default wording synced to the actual reader in src/config/models.ts -- do not invent values) and consider whether the idempotency guard needs to become per-key rather than whole-section. Test convention followed: test/commands/setup-loop-scaffold.test.ts exercises scaffoldLoopSection directly against a tmp-dir fixture (no runSetup/tmux/Ink/claude-availability dependency), mirroring test/commands/setup-models-defaults.test.ts.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Signature parse(input: string): object confirmed unchanged (re-fetched, same as US-001). Docs still don't explicitly document comment-stripping; this story's new AC4 test (parseToml on the scaffolded [loop] section drops the commented meta_loop/worker_isolation/orch_context_window lines) empirically re-confirms the comment-tolerance behavior against the real Bun.TOML.parse, consistent with US-001's finding.
